name: nayara-one-api
description: Nayara One — API do ERP imobiliário/construtora (Fundação Executável / Marco 1).

scripts.load:integracoes: node scripts/withDisposableDb.js -- env LOG_LEVEL=error CI_TENANT_USERS_PASSWORD=ci-tenant-users-password-not-for-production CLAMAV_HOST=127.0.0.1 CLAMAV_PORT=3310 bash -c "node scripts/seed-ci-two-tenants.js >/dev/null && NODE_ENV=test node scripts/loadTestIntegrations.js"
scripts.marketing:drill: node scripts/withDisposableDb.js -- env LOG_LEVEL=error CI_TENANT_USERS_PASSWORD=ci-tenant-users-password-not-for-production CLAMAV_HOST=127.0.0.1 CLAMAV_PORT=3310 bash -c 'node scripts/seed-ci-two-tenants.js >/dev/null && NODE_ENV=test node scripts/marketingDrill.js "$@"' drill
scripts.syntax-check: find app.js src scripts migrations test -name '*.js' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 -P 4 node --check
scripts.test:marketing:mutation: node scripts/withDisposableDb.js -- env LOG_LEVEL=info CI_TENANT_USERS_PASSWORD=ci-tenant-users-password-not-for-production CLAMAV_HOST=127.0.0.1 CLAMAV_PORT=3310 bash -c "node scripts/seed-ci-two-tenants.js >/dev/null && node scripts/marketing/mutation/executar.js --grupo adversariais && node scripts/marketing/mutation/executar.js --grupo adversariais2 && node scripts/marketing/mutation/executar.js --grupo guardas"
scripts.test:contract: node scripts/withDisposableDb.js -- env LOG_LEVEL=info CI_TENANT_USERS_PASSWORD=ci-tenant-users-password-not-for-production CLAMAV_HOST=127.0.0.1 CLAMAV_PORT=3310 bash -c "node scripts/seed-ci-two-tenants.js >/dev/null && NODE_ENV=test node scripts/runContractTests.js"
scripts.test:ai:adversarial: node scripts/withDisposableDb.js -- env LOG_LEVEL=info CI_TENANT_USERS_PASSWORD=ci-tenant-users-password-not-for-production CLAMAV_HOST=127.0.0.1 CLAMAV_PORT=3310 bash -c "node scripts/seed-ci-two-tenants.js >/dev/null && NODE_ENV=test node scripts/ai-adversarial-report.js"
scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.js test/ai/invariantes.test.js test/ai/archGuard.test.js test/marco8/*.test.js test/integrations/*.test.js "test/marco9/**/*.test.js" "test/analytics/**/*.test.js"
